transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
Oh, hello, Doctor. It's very nice to meet you too. Thank you so much for fitting me in, I really hope I'm not wasting your time.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different parts of your life?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I hope I'm answering this right, but no, I don't really sit and fret over things too much. Just the normal little things, you know, like anyone my age would. I try to look on the bright side, mostly. I don't feel overwhelmed by worry or anything like that. Is that... does that make sense for what you're asking?
Do you often feel very afraid that other people will judge you or think badly of you?

Oh, goodness, no. I don't think so. I mean, I care about being polite and making a good impression, of course—I think everyone wants to be liked, don't you? But I wouldn't say I'm *afraid* of it. I certainly don't lose sleep over what people are thinking of me. I try to just be kind and do my best, and I hope that's enough. Does that sound like a normal way to feel about it?
Do you often need a lot of advice or reassurance from other people before you can make everyday decisions?

Oh, no, I wouldn't say I need a lot of advice. I mean, I might ask my daughter what she thinks about a new recipe or something small like that, but I can make my own choices just fine. I try not to be a bother to anyone with silly little things. I've been managing my own household for a long time, so I mostly just trust my own judgment. I hope that's the right answer—I just try to be independent, you know?
Before this current low mood began, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this?

Oh, no, I don't believe so. I mean... everyone has a sad day here and there, don't they? That's just a normal part of life. But a whole period of feeling really low like this... no, I've been quite blessed, mostly. I always just tried to keep a smile on and stay busy with the house and the family, and that usually kept my spirits up. I hope I'm being helpful, but I really don't think I've ever felt quite this way before. Is that... does that answer what you were looking for?
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?

Oh, heavens no. I would never think anything like that. I mean, I know I've been feeling a bit down lately, but life is a gift, isn't it? I have my family, and even when things are a little overwhelming, I try to count my blessings. I'd never want anyone to think I was ungrateful for the life I have. I just try to push through the tough days. That's the right way to look at it, don't you think?
